_source: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited DRHP dated 25-Aug-2025 (SEBI filing 96473) and corrigendum dated 11-Dec-2025; restated consolidated, Rs million in the DRHP converted to Rs crore. Printed page = PDF page. SEBI observation 12-Dec-2025. No price band: the reference price is illustrative (peer-median P/E from the DRHP's own peer table x FY25 EPS).

basis.name: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited
basis.brlm: IIFL Capital Services Limited; JM Financial Limited; Nuvama Wealth Management Limited
basis.outside: none (all figures from the DRHP and its corrigendum)

cites.pat: p. 364 (attributable to owners; total PAT Rs 94.81 / 144.17 / 152.01 cr)
cites.rpt_s: pp. 34-35 (HWTPL services before it became a subsidiary; Turbomax rent)

1.finding: 1:5 split (05-Sep-2024) and 2:1 bonus (05-Sep-2024) are reflected: EPS 10.05 / 15.16 / 15.42 FY23-25 are on the post-bonus count of 9,34,11,270 shares.

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs 30.39 cr / -11.69 cr / 65.51 cr FY23-25 against PAT Rs 94.81 / 144.17 / 152.01 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT about 22% (owners' PAT basis). Working capital rose from 27.8% to 63.5% of revenue as receivable days went 158 -> 197 -> 262. FY25 cash flow recovered as collections improved; typical of a technology supplier paid on municipal STP project milestones, but the trend is the key thing to track.

3.finding: Current tax 26.1% of cumulative FY23-25 PBT; income tax paid Rs 135.80 cr over three years. Profit is taxed in cash.

4.finding: Related-party dealings outside the group are small (Turbomax India purchases Rs 1.58 cr FY25). Large intra-group loans to SWT subsidiaries (Vasudha, HWTPL, Pentagen) are eliminated on consolidation. Dividends Rs 31.14 cr paid in FY25.

5.finding: Fresh issue is amount-based (Rs 150 cr), no fixed share count. Rs 47.46 cr repays debt (company and Vasudha Waste Treatment), Rs 69.67 cr funds working capital, balance GCP (cap 25%) and expenses. No capex object.

7.finding: Goodwill Rs 2.81 cr; other intangibles Rs 7.26 cr are service-concession rights acquired with a subsidiary in Oct-2023, amortised Rs 5.57 cr a year - not capitalised development costs.

8.finding: Top customer 16.76% and top-10 61.37% of FY25 revenue (EPC contractors building municipal STPs); top-10 suppliers 47.71% of purchases. Usual for a project-linked technology supplier.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities tiny (Rs 0.02 cr), but subsidiary SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH faces a EUR 5.60 m (Rs 56.75 cr, 8.7% of FY25 net worth) liquidated-damages suit in Portugal over a 2018 STP supply; defence filed 28-Oct-2024, pending.

R1.finding: G B C A & Associates LLP audit with no qualifications; two overseas subsidiaries (FY25 assets Rs 23.02 cr, revenue Rs 20.07 cr) are consolidated on unaudited, management-certified accounts. Small, but should be audited by the RHP.

R3.finding: Fresh issue Rs 150 cr: a monitoring agency is mandatory above Rs 50 cr; to be named in the RHP.

R6.finding: BRLMs IIFL Capital, JM Financial and Nuvama: IIFL and JM track records are in the desk database; Nuvama not yet compiled.

rationale.g1: Revenue CAGR 15.91% FY23-25 (Rs 519.45 cr -> Rs 697.86 cr), but only +6.1% in FY25 as WWT revenue fell from Rs 524.44 cr to Rs 469.21 cr and the WWT order book from Rs 656.45 cr to Rs 459.75 cr (pp. 49, 449-450). Total order book Rs 1,267.50 cr at 15-Aug-2025 (1.8x FY25 revenue) after Rs 501.70 cr of CBG plant orders and the first WRR order (pp. 49, 262). Neutral 12-15% as the CBG EPC orders execute; Bear assumes WWT stays soft; Bull adds DuPont-led WRR growth (p. 261).
rationale.m: Operating EBITDA (issuer KPI, net of other income) Rs 124.07 / 193.25 / 207.48 cr = 23.89% / 29.39% / 29.73% (p. 170). WWT segment margin 34.7% in FY25; SWT 31.0%; automation 10.4% (p. 450). Neutral 28%, a little below FY25 as lower-margin CBG EPC work grows; Bear 24% (FY23 level); Bull holds 30%.
rationale.nwc: Trade working capital (receivables incl. non-current + inventory - payables) 39.3% / 59.7% / 70.5% of revenue FY23-25 (pp. 362-363); the issuer's own working-capital ratio is 27.8% / 39.9% / 63.5% (p. 34). Neutral 60% assumes part of the FY24-25 build reverses as receivable days come off 262; Bear holds 70%; Bull 50%.
rationale.roic: ROCE 28.57% / 28.56% / 29.29% FY23-25 (p. 170), with net cash. Neutral terminal ROIC 20% allows for a heavier working-capital and SWT asset base.
rationale.capex: No IPO capex. Base capex Rs 30.95 cr (FY25 purchase of PPE incl. CWIP, p. 368). The CBG plants are EPC + O&M orders for an oil marketing company (p. 262); any equity the group must put in is not quantified in the DRHP and is a data gap.

adjustments.reason: The joint venture ceased on 08-Aug-2023 and the associate became a subsidiary; the share of profit (Rs 1.31 cr FY23, Rs 2.41 cr FY24) does not recur.
Insurance claim of Rs 0.52 cr in FY25 other income (WWT segment note).

adjustments.item: Interest on fixed deposits, loans and mutual-fund gains (treasury income)
adjustments.reason: Recurring while the company holds cash, but non-operating; excluding it gives the operating P/E. Shown for information.
